stem: Which action is most consistent with operator-level sensor care when explicitly allowed by procedure?
choices: Opening protected electronics to look for loose connections during a sensor check.
Inspecting cleanliness and visible condition and performing the defined comparison/readiness check when the procedure authorizes it.
Changing calibration coefficients so the sensor agrees with nearby instruments.
Changing HVAC programming so the environment matches the sensor reading.
rationale: Operator-level care generally stays with external inspection, cleanliness, basic status checks, and defined comparisons that the procedure specifically authorizes. Opening protected electronics, rewriting calibration parameters, or changing control logic crosses into servicing or control authority that Technician I does not automatically hold.
